10a10b.reasoning: With widths 3 2 2 and 6 ranks, sc_notify_recursive_nary has depth 2: level 1 (tag NARY+1, pairs) runs before level 0 (tag NARY+0, groups of three). Every peer exists, every rank Isends exactly one (possibly empty) message to each peer and expects nrecv = divn-1 messages, which matches. The MPI_Probe(ANY_SOURCE, tag) at sc_notify.c:1369 is followed by Recv from status.MPI_SOURCE, and the received buffer is placed by slot j computed from the source, so arrival order does not affect the merge result. Tags differ per level, so a fast peer's next-level message cannot be taken. sc_notify_payload_nary ends with MPI_Barrier after all receives, so messages of the second call cannot be matched by the first. The 4-byte payload is below the eager threshold, so no separate payload phase. Isend plus Waitall after receives avoids buffering deadlock.
